category.label: unicode glyphs
category.description: Arrows, box drawing, dingbats, and geometric symbols used in place of plain ASCII or words.

source: Group P research: Wikipedia, Signs of AI writing
notes: Every range skips code points that are also `Extended_Pictographic`, so emoji stay with the `formatting` pack and the dash characters stay with `em-dash`. Prose files stay out of scope for the same reason as `smart-punctuation`. Code comments are out of scope too: a measured pass over 797 library files found arrows in JSDoc examples and box-drawing type diagrams in hand-written comments, and the pack cannot tell those from decoration.
